articles.title: A School Tried a Chatbot Named Jordan to Help Kids Talk About Feelings
articles.summary: A school in Dayton, Ohio, paid $72,600 for AI tools, including a chatbot named Jordan that acts grumpy so students give it advice. There is very little research on whether AI like this actually helps kids.

articles.title: A Salmon Farm in Maine Paused Its $300 Million Project — and Blames Tariffs
articles.summary: A $300 million salmon farm planned for Millinocket, Maine, was about 80% finished when the company paused it indefinitely, blaming Trump's tariffs. Maine does $6 billion in trade with Canada each year.

articles.title: Drone Strikes Hit Kyiv and Other Ukrainian Cities
articles.summary: Russia sent about 120 drones across Ukraine on Monday. At least nine people died, officials say, and a famous science building in Kyiv was hit.
